 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 5 09-01-2025 Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. The petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 498A/323/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner, referring to the mediator's report dated 14.5.2024, submits that parties did not turn up for mediation and thus mediation failed on account of non-appearance of either parties.
Learned counsel, while denying the allegations, submits that the petitioner has falsely been implicated in this case because he is husband of the victim.
Petitioner is ready to keep the victim in matrimonial house with honour and dignity.
The case is triable by the Magistrate.

The petitioner has further relied upon the judgment of this Court in Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.66142 of 2023(5) dt.09-01-2025 the case of Md. Naimul Haque Ansari @ Naimul Haque Ansari & Ors. Vs. The State of Bihar, reported in 2006(3) PLJR 182.
4.
